selection: First 128 records after sorting SHA256("20261010-full-answer-v1|" + id); no task exclusions
retrieval: TF-IDF, fixed top3; highest existing development all-evidence@3 baseline
inference: Only question, raw report candidates and candidate IDs; stripped qa labels, model_input, gold_inds, program and answers. Greedy temperature0, seed20261010, max_new_tokens512, context8192; no test-driven prompt/model/threshold revision.
comparison: Same frozen generator outputs: direct reported numeric answer versus bounded arithmetic execution with operand-source provenance guard. Shared generation budget, not two independent models.
primary_score: Display numeric answer agreement with normalized qa.answer (numeric and percent formatting); report scored reference availability. No private-test leaderboard claim.
secondary_score: Exact rounded5 agreement with FinQA exe_ans; expose disagreements between human-facing answer and exe_ans.
uncertainty: Paired bootstrap2000 with fixed seed20261010 plus Wilson proportions; do not infer all-test accuracy from a fixed sample.
quality_dimensions: cash API spend0; CPU time not free hardware
limitations: public test may contaminate model pretraining
operand occurrence is not semantic entailment or unit/period verification
CPU quantization changes model; no SOTA or production claim
